question.text: 'Gamma Exposure' in an option book refers to:

answer.text: Sensitivity of delta to changes in underlying price — higher gamma means delta moves more per unit price change

explanation.text: The Logic: Gamma = second derivative of option price w.r.t. underlying; measures delta's sensitivity. The Trap: Other Greeks represent different sensitivities. Cross-Exam Context: Core options Greek. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Long gamma benefits from volatile moves; short gamma benefits from stable prices.
